name: PNS Page Loader
author: Partho Samadder

sections.description:
PNS Page Loader is a lightweight, high-performance page transition loader plugin for WordPress. It displays a seamless, aesthetically pleasing loading animation while your website assets, styles, and scripts load in the background.

With extensive customization options, intuitive dashboard controls, and zero third-party framework overhead, PNS Page Loader delivers an exceptional user experience without slowing down your website.

Key Features:

  • Multiple Animation Types: Classic CSS Spinners (Ring, Bouncing Dots, Pulse, Bars, Double Bounce), Custom SVG Files, Logo/Brand Image, and Text Only.
  • Modern Gradients & Dual Colors: Switch seamlessly from solid backgrounds to vibrant multi-directional linear gradients with custom color stops and angles.
  • Glassmorphism & Backdrop Blur: Frosted-glass backdrop filter softly blurs underlying website content with configurable blur strength.
  • Complete Visual Customizer: Custom overlay background colors, opacity levels, animation accent colors, subtitle typography, and dimensions.
  • WordPress Media Library Integration: Easily upload your company logo or custom SVG graphic directly through the native media manager.
  • Smooth Exit Animations: Choose between Fade Out, Slide Upward, or Scale & Fade transitions.
  • Safety Fallback Timeout: Built-in timeout timer ensures visitors are never stuck or locked out if external network resources stall.
  • Display Targeting: Activate the loader across all pages, homepage only, or restrict to specific pages and posts.
  • Smart Performance Limits: Option to disable the preloader on mobile devices and restrict frequency (every page load, once per session, or once per day).
  • 100% Translation Ready: Includes full internationalization support and translation template (.pot).
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress administrator dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  3. Search for PNS Page Loader.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Go to Settings -> PNS Page Loader to configure your animation settings.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP archive.
  2. Upload the pns-page-loader folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Settings -> PNS Page Loader to customize options.
sections.faq:
Can I disable the page loader on mobile devices?

Yes. In the Settings -> PNS Page Loader panel, navigate to the Behavior & Visibility tab and toggle the Disable on Mobile Devices switch.

What happens if a resource on my page takes too long to load?

PNS Page Loader includes an automatic Fallback Timeout limit (customizable in seconds). If the page does not complete loading within this time, the loader fades out automatically to guarantee your visitors always have access.

Can I display the loader only once per visitor session?

Yes. Under the Behavior & Visibility tab, set Loading Frequency Limit to Once Per Session (uses browser sessionStorage) or Once Per Day (uses cookie).

Can I use my own company logo as the loader?

Yes. Select Logo / Custom Image under Loader Animation Type, then upload your logo directly from your media library and choose an optional spinner ring or background shape.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Added 5 CSS spinner presets: Ring, Dots, Pulse, Bars, and Double Bounce.
  • Added SVG animation media support via WordPress Media Library.
  • Added Logo image loader with spinner wrapper options.
  • Added exit animations: Fade, Slide Up, and Zoom Out.
  • Added visibility rules: All pages, Homepage only, and Specific posts/pages.
  • Added frequency limiting: Always, Once per session, and Once per day.
  • Enqueued dynamic inline styles using WordPress core wp_add_inline_style.
  • Fully prefixed all functions, classes, options, transients, and constants.
